A guide to kennel cleaning for a cheerful watch
This page is for you

Companion Animal Travel Desk kennel care and travel readiness

This article helps travelers prepare a clean, calm kennel before the journey begins. At Aurelia Skyways, routine desk work depends on clear records, safe handling, and prompt checks that protect animal comfort. Keep the kennel practical, secure, and easy to inspect before you arrive at the airport.

Start with the inside of the kennel. Remove bedding, toys, and loose items, then check for hair, dampness, or residue. Wipe all surfaces with a pet-safe cleaner, and make sure the kennel is fully dry before you place anything back inside. A clean kennel reduces stress and supports a smoother review at the desk.

Next, inspect the door, latch, vents, and base. Each part should close securely and show no sharp edges, cracks, or loose fittings. If anything feels unstable, replace it before travel day. The welfare coordinator will look for signs that the pet can rest comfortably, move safely, and breathe well during the journey.

The passenger coordinator will also explain the required travel steps in clear order. Keep your pet calm while you prepare, and avoid adding strong scents, wet fabric, or heavy packing materials. If your animal uses absorbent bedding, choose a fresh, dry layer that stays in place and does not block airflow. This simple preparation helps staff complete checks without delay.

If you are traveling with more than one animal, keep each kennel labeled and separated according to the guidance you receive at the desk. Do not share bowls, leashes, or liners between carriers unless staff have approved the arrangement. A neat setup makes the process safer for your pet and easier for the team.

Before you leave, do one final visual check. The kennel should look tidy, smell neutral, and remain secure when lifted or moved. Travel guidance from Aurelia Skyways is concise, kind, and actionable, and it is best followed exactly as given.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel.
